title: Eastern Göktürks
capsule: The Eastern Turkic Khaganate emerged around 581–603 from the division of the First Türk Khaganate, dominating the Mongolian steppe and the routes north of China. Its khagans alternately raided and extracted tribute from the contending Chinese dynasties until a reunified Tang, exploiting a severe winter and internal Türk revolts, decisively defeated Illig Qaghan in 630 and resettled many of his people—ending the first eastern khaganate until its revival in 682.
